# NamSor

NamSor classifies, parses, and enriches personal names to infer attributes such as gender, country of origin, ethnicity, and cultural context.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/namsor/.

## Actions

- **Classify Name Diaspora** (read-only): Infer likely diaspora or ethnicity labels for one or more names within a known country of residence.
- **Classify Name Gender** (read-only): Infer likely gender for one or more first-and-last names.
- **Classify Name Origin** (read-only): Infer likely countries and region of origin for one or more first-and-last names.
- **Classify Proper-Noun Type** (read-only): Classify one or more proper nouns as likely personal names, brand names, place names, or other NamSor types.
- **Classify Residence Country** (read-only): Infer likely countries and region of residence for one or more full personal names.
- **Get Account Usage** (read-only): Return the connected NamSor account's plan, quota, current billing-period usage, limits, and overage summary without exposing its API key.
- **Parse Personal Names** (read-only): Parse one or more full personal names into likely first-name and last-name components.
